battle.name: 梁州之戰
battle.brief: 北魏太武帝拓跋燾乘梁朝宗室相爭，三路大軍南下：西路沿褒斜谷道攻入梁州漢中，劍閣天險橫在前方。魏軍以騎兵長槊為主力，卻在狹窄谷地失掉縱馳之勢；守軍以步兵長矛列陣拒騎，槍牆擋住北方的精騎。糧道千里加秋疫流行，魏軍終退回關中，漢中與蜀道門戶得以保全。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 北魏與南梁是這場衝突的兩方。北魏由太武帝拓跋燾坐鎮平城，於天監四年（505）十一月同時推出三路大軍：中路自率步騎南渡黃河，屯於瓜步臨江；東路由廣陵王拓跋仁率騎攻略琅邪、泰山一帶郡縣；西路則取褒斜谷道，進取梁州（漢中）。北魏的編制以軍、將分層，軍約數千人，將領一部約千餘人上下，鮮卑騎兵居核心，漢人步卒與攻城工匠編為輔兵，拓跋燾自領中樞宿衛與詔令，三路互為犄角而不同進。梁的方面，以梁武帝蕭衍總領，尚書令蕭宏掌中樞與軍國事，中衛將軍蕭偉等宗室重兵在握，彼此交惡；漢中一線由梁州與益州方面軍分守，劍閣、陽平關等蜀道關隘屯戍重兵，荊、雍二州則為策應。西北的仇池，氐族楊氏盤踞關中與漢中之間的門戶之地，成為魏軍西路先行控制的地方。
countriesEn: Northern Wei and Southern Liang were the two sides in this conflict. Under Emperor Wudi, Tuoba Tao, Northern Wei launched three columns at the same time in the eleventh month of the fourth year of Tianshui (505): the central column marched south under the emperor's own command, crossed the Yellow River and encamped at Guabu facing the river; the eastern column under Prince Guangling Tuoba Ren swept the commanderies of Langya and Tai Shan with cavalry; the western column took the Baoxie valley road and moved on Liangzhou, present-day Hanzhong. Northern Wei organised its armies in layers of jun and jiang, a jun numbering several thousand men and a command of a general of roughly a thousand; Xianbei cavalry formed the core, with Han Chinese footmen and engineers attached as auxiliaries, and the emperor kept the central guard and the imperial orders in his own hands so that the three columns would support one another while advancing separately. On the Liang side, Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan, was nominally in overall command, but power lay with the Director of the Secretariat, Xiao Hong, who handled state affairs and the army, while the Colonel of the Imperial Guard, Xiao Wei, and other imperial princes held troops and were bitter rivals; the Hanzhong line was divided between the Liangzhou and Yizhou forces, with heavy garrisons posted at Jiange, Yangping Pass and the other passes of the road to Shu, and Jing and Yong provinces serving as reserves. In the north-west, the Di people of the Yang clan still held the strategic threshold between Guanzhong and Hanzhong, and that area became the first objective of Wei's western column.
people: 北魏方面，總指揮是太武帝拓跋燾。他平定柔然、統一北境之後，是一位漢化的帝王，同時仍把鮮卑騎兵作為國家的骨幹武力；此次三路伐梁是他第一次以正兵直取江南，戰前曾遣使觀察梁的邊防與朝局。東路主帥廣陵王拓跋仁是拓跋氏宗室中善於統騎的將領，在琅邪一線連下郡縣。西路入蜀的部隊，見於《魏書》楊大眼傳、楊播傳者，為鎮西將軍、冠軍將軍一系的西征將領：楊大眼少有膽勇，兼善射與驍捷，屢以先鋒破關；楊播以持重聞名，負責糧道與後隊的接應。南梁這邊，梁武帝蕭衍以招撫羈縻安頓新附之地，尚書令蕭宏出總機務，是主和主緩的一派；中衛將軍蕭偉掌禁兵，素與蕭宏不協，兄弟同室操戈，正是魏軍得以深入的內因。漢中守軍由梁、益兩州的將領分守城隘，姓名散見《梁書》《資治通鑑》諸紀。此役之後，韋睿在鍾離以木車懸槊拒騎，曹景宗、昌義之與他共守孤城，陳慶之於五百二十八年以白袍長槊直入洛陽，把這一戰的兵器邏輯一路傳了下去。
peopleEn: On the Wei side the overall commander was Emperor Wudi, Tuoba Tao, who had settled the Rouran and unified the northern steppe, and who as a sinicised emperor still kept the Xianbei cavalry of his own people as the arm of the state. It was his first attempt to strike deep into the south with regular armies, and he sent envoys ahead to read Liang's frontier deployments and court politics. The eastern column was led by Prince Guangling Tuoba Ren, a member of the imperial clan skilled in handling cavalry, who took commanderies one after another around Langya. The troops that entered Shu came under a western expeditionary command drawn from the line of the generals of the Western Army and the Champion's Army: the Wei History records in the biographies of Yang Dayan and Yang Bo that they served in the campaign against Liangzhou and were rewarded for it. Yang Dayan was a man of daring from youth, an excellent archer and swift in the saddle, and repeatedly forced the passes as a vanguard; Yang Bo, known for steadiness, was trusted with the supply line and the follow-up echelons. On the Liang side, Xiao Yan ruled with a policy of placating and binding the newly submitted territories, and Xiao Hong, the Director of the Secretariat, headed the central government and the military affairs and favoured a cautious, delaying approach. The Colonel of the Imperial Guard Xiao Wei commanded the palace troops, had always been at odds with Xiao Hong, and the quarrel between brothers inside the imperial house was exactly the fault that let the Wei army in. The garrisons of Hanzhong were commanded by generals of Liang and Yizhou who shared the city walls and the passes between them, their names scattered through the Liang History and the Comprehensive Mirror. After this campaign, Wei Rui met the Wei horse with shafts hung from wooden carts at Zhongli, Cao Jingzong and Chang Yizhi held the same isolated city with him, and in 528 Chen Qingzhi rode in with white coats and long spears straight into Luoyang, carrying the weapon logic of this battle down to its end.
kits: 這張卡上的兵器是斯巴達長矛（dory），兩米長的木槍，槍尾包銅套，來源於公元前八世紀的希臘城邦世界。它的價值不在單件，而在它所代表的方陣：密集的持矛步兵互相掩護，槍頭朝前、槍尾抵地，合成整片木與青銅的牆面，關鍵是站得住。五零五年漢中戰場上並沒有希臘人，這面牆在中國的對應物是槊與矛。魏軍騎兵用長柄的槊，刃長而粗，專為衝鋒時以馬力送出槊尖而設；步兵則用矛、戈、戟一類兵器配盾，結陣而前。梁軍在蜀道天險上能守，正靠步兵列陣、長槊交錯與弓弩覆蓋的組合：《武經總要》《手臂錄》所記的槊，正是把矛陣的經驗壓縮成一條攻擊線。兩軍通用裝備還有札甲、鎖子甲與兜鍪，齊、魏皆重騎射，弓、弩分置各軍，強弩更用以射遠距目標；刀與環首刀為近身格鬥所備，漢中兵卒多持大盾。魏軍自涼州、河西徵馬，戰馬是騎槊的前提。攻城方面備有撞車、雲梯、鈎、飛石一類器具，但漢中城郭多土築木柵，器械作用有限。糧食隨軍車隊自關中沿谷道輸送，牛車與騾隊往返數百里，這條補給線的長度，才是決定戰役結局的真正兵器。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Spartan dory, a two-metre wooden spear with a bronze shoe at its butt, dating from the Greek city-state world of the eighth century BC. Its value lies not in the individual weapon but in the formation it represents: a dense body of spearmen shielding one another, points forward and butts braced on the ground, so that the whole phalanx becomes one wall of wood and bronze, and the decisive quality is simply that it could hold its ground. No Greek stood in Hanzhong in 505, but the Chinese counterpart of that wall was the shao and the mao. Wei cavalry carried long-shafted shao, blades long and heavy, made to drive the point forward with the power of the horse; footmen carried the mao, the ge and the ji together with a shield, closing up in line. What allowed the Liang army to hold the passes of Shu was precisely the combination of foot soldiers in line, crossed shao and covering fire from bows and crossbows: the shao described in the Wujing Zongyao and the Shoulu Lu compresses the experience of the spear wall into a single line of attack. Common equipment on both sides included lamellar and mail armour and helmets; both Qi and Wei put emphasis on mounted archery, and bows, crossbows and powerful tension bows were distributed among the units. Swords and ring-pouted sabres served for close fighting, and the soldiers of Hanzhong commonly carried large shields. The Wei army drew its horses from Liangzhou and Hexi, and the warhorse was the precondition of the mounted shao. For siege work the troops brought battering rams, scaling ladders, hooks and stone-throwing engines, but the cities of Hanzhong were mostly earthen walls and wooden palisades, so such machines had limited effect. Food travelled with the army in wagon trains along the valley road from Guanzhong, ox carts and mule teams shuttling over several hundred li, and the true weapon that decided this campaign was the length of that supply line.
tactics: 魏軍的西路自長安出谷，沿褒斜谷道成縱隊前推：先鋒沿兩側山脊行，中軍在谷底，主力騎兵被谷道寬度壓成一條狹長的帶，縱有萬騎也難以展開，只能靠縱隊前衝的慣性。進至漢中盆地的隘口，前鋒以步卒扛盾持柱，肩盾蔽身，強弩與弓手在兩側坡地居高齊射，掩護步隊攀緣土城；騎兵則繞出山口，企圖切斷守軍的糧道與退路。守軍的部署是典型的以險制騎：劍閣一線倚天險設關，漢中城據盆地北口，長槊手在城垣前列陣，槊尖越牆而出，騎兵一旦逼近城壕就被迫在狹窄地形減速，衝鋒的力道被地形吃掉，縱是北方精騎也難以一衝而過，這正是魏軍屢攻不下劍閣的原因。攻守相持數月，秋涼後漢中、褒斜一帶瘧疾流行，軍中病亡與糧秣消耗同時上升，魏軍既無法在山道中展開殲滅戰，也無法長期屯糧，遂在糧道接不上之前主動退兵。同一戰役的另一面，中路拓跋燾屯兵瓜步，試圖以舟船強渡；東路拓跋仁沿海岸線掃掠郡縣，都是以強攻配合西路牽制，兩翼牽制不成，中路與東路亦各自回撤。
tacticsEn: The western column of the Wei army marched out of Chang'an by the valleys and advanced in column of march: the vanguard on the ridges on both sides, the main body in the floor of the valley, and the cavalry pressed by the narrow track into a long thin band, so that even ten thousand riders could not deploy and could only charge on the momentum of the column. On reaching the passes at the mouth of the Hanzhong basin, the vanguard advanced with shielded footmen carrying the beams for the scaling ladders, shields shouldered to cover the body, while strong crossbows and bowmen on the slopes above fired in volleys to cover the footmen climbing the earthen walls. The cavalry rode out around the mouth of the pass, seeking to cut the defenders' supply line and retreat. The defenders deployed in the classic way of using the terrain to check horse: at the Jiange line they held the natural pass, at Hanzhong they held the north mouth of the basin, and spearmen stood in line before the walls with their points projecting over the parapet. Once the riders closed to the moat they were forced to slow in the confined ground, and the force of the charge was eaten away by the terrain; that was why the Wei army could never break through at Jiange. The siege dragged on for months, and when the weather turned cold in autumn, malaria broke out in the damp mountains of Hanzhong and the Baoxie valley, so that sickness and the consumption of grain rose together. Unable to fight a decisive battle of cavalry in a mountain track, and unable to stockpile provisions there, the Wei army withdrew before its supply line could be broken. On the other fronts of the same campaign, Tuoba Tao stationed himself at Guabu and tried to force the crossing with boats and bridges, while Tuoba Ren swept the coastal commanderies: when the flanking pin failed, the centre and the east withdrew as well.
data: 有據可查的數字大致如下。天監四年（505）十一月，北魏三路出師；同月，拓跋燾自將大軍直抵瓜步，與建康隔江相望，《資治通鑑》記魏軍號兵百萬，實際當為數十萬之眾，遠征兵力的上限由此可見。十二月前後，西路軍攻入梁州，漢中城與劍閣前線一度易手，蜀道門戶洞開。以今日公路計，關中長安到漢中約二百五十公里，谷道彎折，實際行程更長，糧隊往返所耗成數倍。魏軍退兵時正值秋末冬初，漢中濕熱山地易起瘧疾，《資治通鑑》記大軍還時疫死者甚眾。同一波南征的結局更可印證：五百零七年，魏主拓跋燾再攻鍾離，韋睿以木車列槊拒其騎兵，魏軍大敗，斬首十餘萬級，淮水漂屍十餘萬；五百零九年再攻鍾離與壽春又無功而還。梁州一役是北魏第一次把兵鋒送進漢中，卻沒有第二次把漢中守住。
dataEn: The figures that can be put on record are roughly as follows. In the eleventh month of the fourth year of Tianshui (505) Northern Wei put three columns into the field; in the same month Tuoba Tao led the main army to Guabu, facing Jiankang across the river, and the Comprehensive Mirror records that the Wei host numbered a million, which in fact meant some several hundred thousand men, and the ceiling of the expedition's strength is visible in that figure. Around the twelfth month the western column broke into Liangzhou, and Hanzhong and the approaches to Jiange changed hands for a time, opening the gate of the road to Shu. Measured by today's roads, Chang'an in Guanzhong lies about 250 kilometres from Hanzhong, and the twisting valley road makes the marching distance longer, while the grain teams paid several times that in round trips. The Wei army withdrew at the turn of autumn into winter, and the damp uplands of Hanzhong breed malarial fever easily; the Comprehensive Mirror records that many of the army fell sick and died on the return. The outcome of the same offensive confirms the pattern. In 507, at Zhongli, Tuoba Tao attacked again, Wei Rui met the Wei horse with shao hung from wooden carts, and the Wei host was destroyed, with more than a hundred thousand taken by the sword and more than a hundred thousand floating in the Huai. In 509 the attacks on Zhongli and Shouchun achieved nothing. Liangzhou was the first time Northern Wei had driven troops into Hanzhong, and it was not the second time it held them.
cause: 打起來的理由有三層。第一層是北魏的整體戰略：太武帝拓跋燾在平定柔然、統一北境之後，志在解決南北分立；既然南齊已亡、梁朝新立而邊防未固，他便把目標放在先取淮南與漢中兩翼，試圖把防禦線推到江北大關以外。第二層是梁朝內部的裂痕：梁武帝蕭衍即位後大削宗室權力，諸王怨望叢生；尚書令蕭宏以外戚與宰輔之柄持中樞，出總戎事而賞罰失當，中衛將軍蕭偉掌禁兵，兄弟同床各夢，隨著蕭嶷、蕭偉相繼被削，朝廷上下人人自危，外強中乾，消息傳到平城，正合魏軍之意。第三層是邊境的拉鋸：太建以來，壽春、汝南、義陽、司州一帶的城邑數度易主，兩國的屯戍與游騎年年相攻，農隙與秋收全耗在邊線上；蕭衍既不能一舉反攻收復失地，便只能在固守與示弱之間搖擺，拓跋燾則把這份僵持當成了可乘之機，於是選在梁國力最盛的秋後出兵，一舉把三路戰線推到家門之前。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason for the war. The first was the overall strategy of Northern Wei: after settling the Rouran and unifying the north, Emperor Wudi Tuoba Tao was determined to end the division between north and south; seeing that the Southern Qi had just fallen and the new Liang dynasty had not yet secured its frontier, he set his aim at taking the two wings of Huainan and Hanzhong, trying to push the defensive line beyond the great passes north of the river. The second was the fissure inside the Liang court: after taking the throne, Emperor Wu Xiao Yan stripped the imperial princes of real power, and resentment spread among them. Xiao Hong, the Director of the Secretariat, holding the highest administrative office as both a leading consort and the chief minister, handled the central government and the army but distributed rewards and penalties badly; the Colonel of the Imperial Guard Xiao Wei held the palace troops, and the brothers in one bed dreamed of different things. As Xiao Yi and Xiao Wei were stripped in turn, the court was on edge at every level, hollow at the core, and word of all this reached Pingcheng, which suited the Wei army perfectly. The third was the attritional struggle along the border: since the Taijian era the towns of Shouchun, Runan, Yiyang and the Sizhou region had changed hands repeatedly, the two states' garrisons and raiding parties fought year after year, and the whole of the farming slack and the autumn harvest was consumed on the frontier. Unable to counterattack in one stroke and recover what had been lost, Liang could only oscillate between holding firm and appearing weak, and Tuoba Tao read that stalemate as his opportunity. He therefore chose to send out his armies in the autumn, when Liang's strength was greatest, and push three fronts at once to the enemy's doorstep.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接影響，是梁朝的邊防結構被徹底改寫。北魏第一次摸到漢中與劍閣，證明關中通向蜀道的門戶並非不可突破，但也證明魏軍的騎兵在谷道之中無用武之地，必須重新思考以步制騎的戰法。於是南朝的兵學重心悄悄轉向：一方面固守天險、據城以俟，把劍閣與漢中的城防層層加固；另一方面發展出車壘懸槊一類以車為牆、以槊為刃的戰術，五百零七年鍾離之役把這種戰術推到頂點，陳慶之五百二十八年以白袍長槊直入洛陽，則是同一條技術路線的終點式演出。對梁朝本身，這次兵變式的出征也加速了皇權的收攏：尚書令蕭宏統兵敗於石亭，中樞威信重挫，宗室諸王相繼被削，蕭衍得以把權力收回宮中。對北魏，代價更為深遠：連年南征耗盡關中的積儲與民力，涼州軍馬與河南糧食無一不減，兵力越打越疲；加之河北六鎮在四百二十年代相繼叛亂，河南漢人聚居區爆發蓋吳起義，北方帝國的財政與兵源同時崩緊。南強北弱的格局，就在這幾年之間悄悄定型，直到侯景之亂才被打破。
impactEn: The immediate effect of this war was a complete rewriting of Liang's defensive structure. Northern Wei had touched Hanzhong and Jiange for the first time, proving that the gateway from Guanzhong to the road of Shu could be broken, but also proving that Wei cavalry had no room to work in a valley track and that the question of checking horse with foot soldiers had to be rethought. The centre of gravity of southern military thinking therefore shifted quietly in two directions: on the one hand, to hold the natural passes and build city after city, hardening the defences of Jiange and Hanzhong in layers; on the other, towards the tactic of the wagon redoubt with shao hung from it, using carts as a wall and shao as the edge, which reached its height at Zhongli in 507 and whose final performance was Chen Qingzhi's entry into Luoyang with white coats and long spears in 528. For Liang itself, this disastrous expedition also hastened the tightening of royal power: Xiao Hong's defeat at Shiting destroyed the prestige of the central government, the princely houses were stripped in turn, and Xiao Yan was able to draw power back to the palace. For Northern Wei the cost was deeper. Years of southern campaigns drained the reserves and the manpower of Guanzhong; the horses of Liangzhou and the grain of Henan alike grew scarcer, and the army grew ever more exhausted. Add the revolts of the Six Garrisons in the north in the 420s and the Gou Wu rising among the Han settlements of Henan, and the finances and the recruitment of the northern empire were both tightening at once. The pattern of a strong south and a weak north was settled in these few years, and was not to be broken until the Hou Jing rebellion.
result: 結局是攻方得地而不能守。魏軍西路一度攻入梁州，漢中與劍閣前的蜀道諸隘盡落敵手，益、荊兩州人心震動，劍閣守軍一度退保；然而谷道太窄，糧隊難繼，秋疫又起，魏軍既拿不出足夠兵力四面合圍，也無法在山道中展開殲滅性的騎兵戰，只能在糧道接不上之前退回關中，漢中重歸梁朝。中路在瓜步未能渡江，東路在琅邪所掠有限，三路皆無戰果，全軍於天監四年底至五年初悉數北撤，這場南征以深入而不能久據收場。次年蕭宏統重兵反攻，在石亭一戰中大敗於魏，攻守之勢就此逆轉，魏軍此後再攻鍾離、壽春均無所獲。梁州的勝負並沒有改變南北對峙的基本格局，卻留下兩個長期的後果：一是北魏意識到正面南下的代價太高，日後的南征規模趨於減縮；二是南朝確認了蜀道與江淮兩翼都可能失守，築城、設險、練槊的風氣在梁朝軍中一直延續到侯景之亂前後。
resultEn: The outcome was a victor who took the ground and could not keep it. The western column of the Wei army broke into Liangzhou; Hanzhong and the passes before Jiange fell to the enemy, the people of Yizhou and Jing provinces were shaken, and the garrisons at Jiange fell back for a time. Yet the valley road was too narrow, the grain teams could not keep up, and malarial fever broke out in autumn, so that Wei could bring neither enough troops for a simultaneous encirclement nor room for a decisive battle of cavalry in the mountain tracks. It had to fall back towards Guanzhong before its supply line snapped, and Hanzhong returned to Liang. The centre made no crossing at Guabu, and the east won little in Langya; with all three columns fruitless the whole army withdrew north between the end of the fourth and the beginning of the fifth year of Tianshui, and this southern campaign ended as one that penetrated deep but could not garrison. The following year Xiao Hong counterattacked with massed troops and was badly beaten by Wei at Shiting, reversing the balance of attack and defence, and Wei's later attempts on Zhongli and Shouchun achieved nothing. The outcome of Liangzhou did not change the basic pattern of northern and southern confrontation, but it left two long-term consequences: Northern Wei understood that the cost of a direct southern advance was too high, and its later expeditions grew smaller in scale; and the southern court, having confirmed that both the road to Shu and the wings of Huainan could be lost, kept building walls, holding passes and drilling spearmen in the Liang army right up to the time of the Hou Jing rebellion.
